mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel bshad 'thad pa'i
'od 'bar

gnyis pa kir ti'i 'bre shes rab ni kha cig
mkhyen gsuM rgyu'i dus na sbyor bzhi 'bras bu'i dus na chos sku rgyu 'bras kyis khyad par du ma byas pa rang bzhin yin la lo tsha ba rgya che shos mkhyen gsuM du sbyor bzhi 'du bar 'dod kyis nga ni sbyor ba'i chos sku bsdoms par yang mkhyen gsuM 'dus so zhes smra'o ||

gsuM pa ni
kha ciglo tsha ba mkhyen pa gsuM ni dus gsuM car dang 'brel ba rang gzhan thams cad kyi rgyud la thun mong ba 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi rgyud la skye ba thos bsam gyis gtan la dbab pa'i yul shes bya rgya mtsho lta bu yin la sbyor bzhi chos sku ni bdag nyid dang 'brel ba'i rgyu
'bras kyi gnas skabs mngon rtogs nyung zad skra rtse'i chu tshod tsam yin pas der ci ste mi 'du zhes gsung ngo ||

bzhi pa ni kha cigar mkhyen gsuM mtshon byed kyi chos sum bcu la mkhyen
gsuM zhes bya la des sbyor bzhi chos sku bsdus so zhes grags so ||
des na 'bre nyan rang gi gzhi shes yin no ||
de la kha cig rgya yon tan seng ge snang pa nyid dgag bya yin te nyes pa thams cad 'di las byung pas so zhes zer ro ||

2 pa ni kha 1rma bya snang ba la bden par zhen pa dgag bya'i chos yin
te ¦ 'dir ni sdug bsngal rgyur gyur pa'i || bden par rtog pa bzlog bya yin zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro zhes zer ro ||
dang po ni kha 1phya pa sgrub bya snang ba dang bden pas stong pa tshogs don yin la de dag kyang rim pa ltar kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa yin no ||

dang po ni kha cig rgya dmar rtags dang rjes dpag gis cir yang ma grub pa'i spros bral sgrub cing 'jal gyi stong nyid bden pa gnyis ka ltar yang yongs
gcod du ma grub bo zer ro ||
dang po ni kha 1gangs pa du ma la gcig yod par 'brel la du ma de gcig yin par 'gal bas skyon 2 ka med do zhes grag go ||

shes rab kyi zhes pa la sogs la kha cig phya pa sgrub byed
mthong pa yin te de yang rjes dpag tshad mas grub pa las rtags dgod pa ni stong nyid sgom pa'i blo chos can | goms pa'i yan lag dang ma bral na gsal ba mthar thug 'byung nges te rten brtan zhing goms pa las ngang gis khyad par du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro || 'dod pa la sogs goms pa bzhin no
zhes smra ba mi 'thad pa la gnyis las khyab pa mi 'thad pa ni rgyu tshogs pa la 'bras bu skyed nges kyis ma khyab pa'i phyir ro || gal te goMs pa'i yan lag dang ma bral na zhes pa'i mtha' gzhan bkag pa'i nges pa sgrub pas skyon med ces pa 'khrul te rtag pa mtha' bzung ste
tshad mas ma grub pa'i phyir ro ||

2 pa phyogs chos mi 'thad pa ni rten brtan pa ni rig pa thug med yin la de yang kha 1 rgya maTentative identification of "rgya ma"as rGya dmar ba Byang chub grags 'chi ba'i shes pa chos can shes pa phyi ma skyed nges te shes pa tsam yin pa'i phyir ro da ltar gyi shes pa'i rtags la rten pa'i rjes dpag gis grub ces zer ro ||

bzhi pa ni kha 1 rgya mar gang
zag du mas 'jug pas log rtog zlog pa la sogs pa dgos pa du mas 'jug srid pas snga ma thams cad mi 'gal lo zhes so ||

gnyis pa grangs nges pa la gsum las | rtog pas btags pa dgag pa ni | kha 1 rtsang dgos med dang | sgrub mi nus dang | 'dod bya ma yin pa dang | ma 'brel ba'i log rtog bzlog pa la bzhir nges so || de yang brjod bya bstan pas sgrub mi nus
bzlog ces so | kha 1 lo tsha dgos pa bstan pas de bzlog ces smra'o ||

gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid la gsum las ¦ rtog pas btags pa dgag pa ni | nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang gnyen po gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid se 'bre"Se" is understood to refer to be the author's teacher dge bshes Se dmar ba (ID:3886), but it could also be Jo bo Se btsun (ID:6763). "'Bre" is understood to refer to 'Bre shes rab 'bar (ID:3807) but could also refer to gTsang pa 'bre sgur (ID:3872). Stoltz argues in favor of the former (Stoltz 2022 [4LWBNM7B]: 121) gzhi thams cad gang zag gi bdag med dang | gang zag gi bdag dang gzung ba rang bzhin med
pa tsam dang bdag mtha' dag skye ba med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'o zhes so |
'di la kha 1 gnyal nyan rang la chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa yod pas de mi rigs so zhes so ||

rnam kun gyi mtshan nyid la
gsuM las rtogs pas btags pa dgag pa ni skye med rnam 'dul gsuM bsdus nas sgom zhes so ||

rtse mo'i mtshan nyid la gsum las ¦ rtog pas btags pa dgag pa ni dbang du gyur pa thob pa'i sgom pa'o 'bre zhes pa mi 'thad de nyan rang la rtse mo'i sbyor ba
yod par thal ba'i phyir ro |
kha cig 'dul skye med gsum bsdus nas dbang du gyur pa thob pa'i sgom pa zhes so |

kha cig rtsang 'bre de'i steng du chos sku thob pa'i phyir zhes pa la 'dod pa mi 'thad de | rnaM kun bkag pa des 'di yang khegs pa'i phyir dang | de gsum ka
ltar na yang tshogs lam na rtse mo yod par thal te | dran pa nyer bzhag la dbang du gyur pa thob pas so ||

de 'dod na rtse mo ye shes kyi don yin la tshogs lam na rnam shes las med pas de med ces pa'i khas blangs dang 'gal lo || ma grub na
bzod pa'i gnas skabs na dbang po lnga la dbang du gyur pa ma thob ces mtshungs so ||

'dir bla mas rtsang 'bre skye med gsum bsdus sgom sangs rgyas kyi sar yod par 'dod pa dang gzhan du sbyor ba tsam gyi mtshan nyid du 'dod pa ni mtshon bya med kyang mtshan nyid srid par thal ba gang
gis zlog |

skad 1 ma'i mtshan nyid la 3
las ¦ rtog pas btags pa dgag pa ni kha 1 'bre brtan pa thob pa'i sgom pa'o zhes so ||
kha 1 rtsang 'bre chos sku thob pa'i don du brtan pa thob pa'i sgom pa'o zhes grag go || de mi 'thad de sa 'og ma dag na dran pa nyer bzhag la brtan pa thob pa yod pas de yod par thal lo ¦¦
so sor phye ba dang bsdus pa yin zhes 'bum pa gsung lo ||
yang kha 1 rtsang sngar rtogs pa'i byed pa ma nyams pa'i don la sgro 'dogs dang 'gal bar 'jug pa yin la de'ang | tshad ma gnyis dang yid dpyod kyi 'jug tu skyes pa ste gsum du nges so zhes grag go |

gnyis pa ni
kha 1 ar gal te drod
kyis kun nas nyon mongs kyi gzung ba med par rtogs pa na gzhan rang bzhin med par rtogs sam ma rtogs | dang po ltar na rim pa ltar 'jog pa mi 'thad la | gnyis pa ltar na nyi tshe ba'i stong par 'gyur ro zhe na |
kha 1 'dul rtog pa drod kyi skabs su'ang bzhi ka
stong par rtogs so || rim pa ltar 'jog pa'ang 'thad de srab mo ngo gsar du ldan no zhes smra'o ||
yang gnyal bla ma dag rtogs pa sa dang po dang spangs pa sa brgyad par 'dus ces pa mi 'thad de | sgom lam gang yang ma skyes shing sgom spang gi nyon mongs pa chung gsuM yod pa'i phyir ro ||

dang po ni
kha 1 tho ston spyi'i mtshan nyid bden bzhi de kho na nyid sngar ma mthong ba mthong ba'o || zhes so ||

gsuM pa rtogs pa'i rtogs tshul gyis dbye ba la gsuM
las |
rtog pas btags pa dgag pa ni
kha 1 khu 'brom"Khu" is understood to refer to Khu ston brTson 'grus g.yung drung (ID:4235), but could also be Khu mDo sde 'bar (ID:3873)'. chos bzod dang chos shes ma dag pa dang dag pa rtogs par gzhag ste ma dag pa chos mchog man chad las khad nye ba dang ring bas zhes so ||
kha 1 rgya gnyanThe identification of "gnyan" as g.Yor gnyan (ID:3837) is tentative. mthong lam dang mthong spang skye 'gag byed bzhin pa dang des
dben pas so zhes smra'o ||
kha 1 karThe identification of "kar" as 'Dul 'dzin dkar mo (ID:3820) is tentative. rgyud sgom spang dang mthong spang gis ma dag pa dang dag pas so zhes grag go ||

dang po ni
kha 1 khu chos bzod chos shes gnyis ni mthong spang rgyun gcod pa dang thag sring pa'i bar chad med pa dang rnam grol gyi lam gnyis su skye la | rjes bzod rjes shes ni gnyis kar 'du ste | 'di ltar chos bzod kyis chos nyid ma dag pa mthong ba na de 'jal gyi ye shes de nyid kyi gzhan
rig gi chos nyid rtogs pa dang | rang rig gi cha'i chos nyid rtogs pa la rjes bzod rjes shes su 'jog go || chos shes kyis chos nyid dag pa mthong ba na ye shes de nyid kyi gzhan rig dang rang rig gi cha'i chos nyid rtogs pa'i cha nas rjes bzod
rjes shes su 'jog go || de ltar yang bzod pa dang shes pa thams cad kyang mtshan ma med pas gnas pa'i rnal 'byor can du rig par bya'o zhes chos nyid kyi yul can kho nar bshad pas shes so zhes grag go ||

dang po ni 'ban mnyam bzhag skad 1 1 du skye ste | bsdu ba las 'bras bu'i mngon par rtogs pa skad 1 ma 1 yin la zhes pa dang | don dam pa so so rang gis rig pa'i ye shes kyi dbang
du bya ste skad 1 ma 1 yin la zhes bshad pas so ||

dang po ni kha 1 phya pa stonUnclear whether "ston" is to be read with "phya pa" or refers to someone else. chos mchog chen po kho na
gnyen po yin gyi mthong lam ni ma yin gyi gnod pa ma bskyal ba'i phyir ro zhes zer ba ni mi rigs te 'ga' zhig gis gnod pa ma bskyal bar ma grub la grub kyang spangs pa thag sring gi gnyen po yang gnyen por gsungs pas gnod do ||

su ka taTentative identification of "su ka ta"as Sugataśrī (ID:6616) na re sa brgyad pa la'o ||
'brom na re sa bcu pa sangs rgyas kyi sa yin
pas dgu pa la'o ||
khyung po dang dhaThe identity of "dha" is not clear. na re sa bcu pa'i dkyil stod la yin te byang chub sems dpa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir ro ||

gnyis pa ni dags khyung la sogs pa rnaM rtog
bzhi po spong ldan pa zhes te rtog pa bzhi spang bya yin la de spong pa'i gnyen pos khyad par du 'phags so zer ba ni mi 'thad de |

dgos pa ni lam shes kyi rtogs bya lam bden la nyer dgu 'byung ba de bden pa dang po gsum gyi steng du nyer dgu 'byung bas yin no snyam
du yul dang yul can gyi 'brel ba go ba yin no || dngos la gnod pa ni gsum po'i rnam pa lam shes kyi rtogs byar 'gal ba'o || des na yul can lam shes kyi rtogs bya'i ming gis yul lam bden gyi rtogs bya la btags so 'dul gsung ngo || kun
'byung dang lam gyi brgyad dang bdun po 'di dngos su bshad ces kha 1 rtsang 'chad do ||

gnyis pa mtshan nyid dang mtshon bya ni rdzas yod btags yod kyi yin pas
de gnyis kyi khyad par ni kha 1 phya rtsang rnam 'jog chos gzhan nges pa la mi ltos pa dang ltos pa'o zer ba ni mi 'thad de |

dang po btags pa dgag pa ni kha 1 ar
mkhyen gsuM gyi rtogs pa gang rung skyed byed mtshan nyid du bkod pas kyang sangs rgyas skyed byed du mtshon nus so zhes gsung pa mi 'thad de mtshan nyid la ldog pa gsuM byung pas mtshon bya la'ang tha dad pas 1 skyed byed mtshan nyid du bzhag pan 2 po'i mtshon bya la ma khyab pa'i phyir dang nyan
rang gi sbyor ba la'ang gzhi shes kyi rtogs pa skyed byed yod pa'i phyir sangs rgyas skyed byed yod par thal lo ||

brgyad stong pa
dang nyi khri las rang dang gzhan de bzhin gshegs par gyur pa la sogs par mdo nas bshad pa'i 'khor mang pos bskor nas chos ston pa bsdu'o || mdo gnyis la rmi ka sla'i khyad yod do 'dul 'dzin zer ro ||

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces
bya ba'i 'grel bshad 'thad pa'i 'od 'bar zhes bya ba | shes bya'i nam mkha' la blo gros kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas shing | legs smra'i 'od kyis phas rgol mun pa'i smag rum sel bar byed pa shAkya'i dge slong rigs par
smra ba shes rab 'od zer gyis sbyar ba rdzogs so || × || dag cing snyoms pa shes rab 'bum gyis bris | dge'o | || |
